sn35.128:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn35.128:1.2: Atha kho Soṇo gahapatiputto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Soṇo gahapatiputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.128:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti ||
sn35.128:1.4: ko pana hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || ||
sn35.128:1.6: Ayaṃ kho Soṇa hetu ayam paccayo || yena-m-idhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti || || 1
